games.title: Packet Catcher
games.author: c-cade
games.description: Move the firewall to catch good packets and keep the malware out. The starter game, and a working reference for the whole Lua API.

games.title: Ping
games.author: c-cade
games.description: Solo pong. Every bounce is worth more than the last, and the ball speeds up as the rally grows.

games.title: Key Rain
games.author: c-cade
games.description: Home-row letters fall from the sky. Type them before they land. The lower a key is when you zap it, the fewer points you get.

games.title: Coffee Break
games.author: c-cade
games.description: Stop the pour while the marker is over the cup. The cup shrinks as you go, and a centred pour scores double.
